text:
sam-customer: hitting a build failure when upgrading to the Go SDK v2 tag, can anyone confirm?

sam-customer: repro steps:
1) add dependency: `require github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2 v2.0.0` in go.mod
2) `go mod tidy`

sam-customer: error:
```
go: github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2@v2.0.0: parsing go.mod:
module declares its path: github.com/redwood-inference/go
	but was required as: github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2
```

sam-customer: full go.mod snippet:
```
module example.com/foo

go 1.20

require (
    github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2 v2.0.0
)
```

maria-support: thanks for the report — sorry for the break. can you share what `go env GOPROXY` is and whether you're behind a private proxy?

sam-customer: GOPROXY is default (https://proxy.golang.org,direct). other teams on our side get same error.

alex-eng: this looks like the classic v2 semver import path mismatch — the module file inside the v2 tag probably still declares `module github.com/redwood-inference/go` instead of `module github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2`.

alex-eng: confirm: the SDK's v2 releases need the module path updated to `/v2` per Go's semver rules. if the tag was created without adjusting module path, `go` will complain like this.

jin-sdk: digging in now, thanks for the repro @sam-customer. I'm seeing the same when I fetch `v2.0.0` locally.

jin-sdk: quick workaround: use v1.x until we cut a proper v2 release, or use a temporary replace that points at our main branch commit that includes the /v2 module path fix. example replace (temporary):
```
replace github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2 => github.com/redwood-inference/go v0.0.0-20260301-abcdef123456
```
note: that replace points to a pseudo-version of the repo where we've updated go.mod to `module github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2` on the commit `abcdef123456`. it's a stopgap.

sam-customer: thanks — any ETA for a proper tagged fix? we can't keep the replace hack in our prod CI.

jin-sdk: we're cutting a patch release now. creating issue + changelog. will push v2.0.1 (or v2.0.0+fix) with corrected go.mod within the hour.

devx: i'll coordinate docs/upgrade note so customers know to import `/v2` and to run `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2@latest` after we publish.

maria-support: i've opened an escalation ticket and linked to the SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go/issues/4321 — adding engineering oncall.

deploy-bot: release pipeline triggered for tag `v2.0.1-fix-gomod` by jin-sdk at 2026-03-17T15:12:00Z :rocket:

alex-eng: once v2.0.1 is published, the correct sequence for customers is:
1) `go get github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2@v2.0.1`
2) ensure imports use `github.com/redwood-inference/go/v2` (no implicit v1 path)
3) `go mod tidy`

sam-customer: confirmed the patched tag works for me locally — build completes and tests pass. thanks all. please ping when the release hits the proxy so we can flip CI.

maria-support: closing out here after we verify propagation to proxy and a short follow-up email to customers who hit this. thanks for fast turnaround team. :thumbsup:
